# 2026-04-30 `platform-architecture-implementation-consistency-audit_round` Per-ID Re-audit Results

This document is the per-ID re-review result of `docs_zh/reviews/platform-architecture-implementation-consistency-audit_round.md`.

Principles:

- Do not directly reuse historical long-table conclusions.
- Only write "fixed/resolved" when there is real source code, contract, ADR, configuration, or targeted test evidence.
- For items that do not change code, clearly state the basis; do not fabricate fixes.
- No full test suite execution.

Scale notes:

- Original line entries: 3490
- Unique IDs: 2640
- Duplicate IDs: 850
- Numeric IDs go up to `2604`, plus round IDs like `R2-1` to `R32-55`.
- New unique IDs added in this re-audit: 1334.

Real issues directly fixed and verified by targeted tests in this round:

- `R2-6`: `BudgetGuard`'s pack/platform result type and legacy normalization gap.
- `R4-37`: `network-egress-policy` default `deny` mode did not actually block, and `audit_only` environment mode parsing drift.
- Stale test assertions in the autonomy / proactive trigger family: medium-risk old assertion still required `auto_execute`; TrustScorer old assertion still pinned low-risk `fully_trusted` to `semi_auto`.
- `R5-49`: `KnowledgeQueryService` had scope input but did not bind `accessPrincipal` into the service-layer boundary check.
- `R22-31`: `TransactionalEventAppender` only wrapped event/outbox, no truth mutation hook, unable to guarantee truth+event in the same transaction.
- `R22-47`: Recovery classification still exposed `L1/L2/L3` externally, not aligned with canonical `transient/permanent/unknown`; also fixed several real misclassification priority issues.
- `R5-59`: `ADR-002` still had residual "VP orchestration layer / business division" wording, mixed with the already-migrated DomainDescriptor/BusinessPack main line.
- `R5-63`: In the ADR source section batch, `ADR-002/004/028` still had old section numbers or old narrative residue, needed to add current canonical references.
- `2580`: Although `SqlExecutionMetricsProvider` had changed incident counting to per failed status, `lastIncidentAt` and the old test still used `last_error_code` semantics, causing re-audit basis to continue drifting.
- `2575`: `DashboardWebSocketServer`'s metric routing previously only had the consumer end, no subscription registration end; this round completed the registration/update/cleanup chain.
- `2568`: Although `AutonomyGovernanceService` recognized `P0/P1`, the old severity branch dropped `promotion.targetLevel`, so high-severity incidents would not actually trigger suggested downgrade; this round fixed it.
- `2585`: The old "fix" of `addWorkspaceMembership()` had no real caller context, only re-read owner membership; this round wired `callerUserId` into the service/CLI boundary and performed real authorization.
- `2586`: The old `addOrganizationMembership()` implementation had neither caller principal nor depended on non-existent `organization.ownerId`; this round changed to `createOrganization()` explicitly establishing owner membership, then using `callerUserId` for member management authorization.
- `R5-28`: `GoalDecompositionService` previously only exposed capability/permission boundary violations, but task envelope would not produce the final permission set narrowed by domain; this round added real task-level permission narrowing while preserving mismatch warnings.
- `R14-22`: Although the old `authoritative-task-store-decorator` implementation no longer used a global metrics Map, synchronous retry still relied on blocking wait as fallback; this round removed `SharedArrayBuffer`/blocking sleep, replaced with instance-level metrics + async non-blocking backoff + synchronous immediate retry.
- `R15-02`: SDK version handshake test still treated `initialize()` as returning handshake result per old interface; this round rewrote to explicit `performVersionHandshake()` call, and strengthened the re-audit evidence for `R15-01/02/03`.
- `R15-49/50/51/52/53/54/55/58/59/60/61/65/66/67/68/69`: Round 15's multi-region/resource manager/Marketplace/SLA residual entries were previously conservatively held as "not changed this round"; this round re-reviewed current source code and added `tests/unit/scale-ecosystem/reaudit-r15-multi-region-resource-manager-regressions.test.ts`, uniformly writing back fencing epoch, failover reconciliation, write routing, cross-border compliance chain, multi-dimensional quota, promotion budget, tenant-scoped pool as resolved.
- `2237`: `DurableEventBus.ensurePendingAcksForActiveConsumers()` previously created pending ack for active consumers not registered to that eventType, causing false backlog counts; this round filtered by event registration table.
- `2246`: `EvalRunService` previously treated `feedbackEnvelope.signals` directly as `actualEvidenceRefs`, mixing legacy reason/signal with evidence; this round prioritizes reading step `evidenceRefs`, only falling back to flat signals when legacy run has no step evidence.
- `2247`: `governance-projection` had removed the wrong inference of unknown `decision*` events to `approval_granted`; during re-verification this round also found that the projection handler directly returned the internal `_processedEventIdSet` without serializing back to `processedEventIds`, causing dedup state unable to persist, this real implementation issue was also fixed.
- `2249/2250`: `access-model` now only trusts capability obtained from role inheritance, and converged `manualTakeoverActive` to "record-only and only available to operator-grade principal" context marker; this round also fixed the default-allow regression exposed during validation, restoring the normal path "allow after capability and context check pass".
- `2251/2254/2255/2256`: OIDC path now prohibits falling back to mock user when `allowMockFallback=false`, uses `timingSafeEqual` to validate access token, limits concurrent sessions per user and implements `touchSession()` sliding expiration; this round completed the corresponding targeted validation, and incidentally fixed the ESM `require()` runtime error of PKCE helper.
- `2236/2239/2240`: `FeedbackSignal` now enforces `trustScore/evidenceRefs` with canonical `harnessRunId/nodeRunId`; `workflow-run-projection` for `subtask:failed` has been changed to only record failed steps, not immediately marking workflow as failed; and projection dedup main chain has been uniformly switched to internal `Set` instead of `Array.includes()`.
- `2257/2258/2259`: `PolicyEngine`'s `full-auto` no longer bypasses high-risk escalation; `VaultHttpSecretProvider` no longer caches AppRole token missing `lease_duration` for 1 hour by default; `DataClassificationService` rejects unsafe regex before running, avoiding user-defined patterns triggering ReDoS.
- `R7-42/R7-43/R7-47` and `2292/2293/2295/2296/2298/2300`: HTTP API main chain previously scattered idempotency, version negotiation, trace propagation, and task creation fact append in local components, not really wired to the request entry; this round converged to `HttpApiServer` main chain and added task creation truth+event same transaction.
- `2278-2291`: Round 39's CLI/SDK continuous entries have all been re-reviewed; among them, `migrate-sqlite-to-pg`, `api-server`, `harness-sdk`, `admin-sdk`, `billing`, `shadow-snapshot`, `data-plane`, `client-sdk` mostly fall under re-audit conclusion lag, while `dlq-manager` and `login` have real gaps, this round added transaction/audit/archive/schema alignment respectively, as well as truly executable PKCE OAuth CLI entry and ESM secure persistent storage.
- `2302`: Although `ServiceRegistry` already had `createScoped()`, the default entries of top-level bootstrap/runtime catalog/runtime orchestrator/root summary still implicitly bound to `getInstance()`; this round uniformly switched these production assembly defaults to `createScoped()`, only sharing when explicitly passed registry.
- `2203`: The real implementation of `remote-session-state` has long since converged `failed` to `connecting` when receiving `connected` signal, but the re-audit entry and corresponding unit test still remain at the old bug narrative; this round rewrote to "must reconnect handshake first" current semantics, and fixed the failing test import path.
- `2192/2193/2195/2196/2197/2198/2199/2204`: In Round 37's multi-tenant/multi-region early entries, some have actually been truly fixed by subsequent implementations but not written back, while `2194` still has a real scheduled flush bypass, this round closed the scheduled flush back to `DataReplicatorService.flush()` main chain, and added targeted evidence for boundary/latency/capacity/queue/sequence number.
- `R11-35`: The `POST` path of `prompt-routes` has long used strongly-typed schema, but the same file's `PUT /deprecate` still has residual `readJsonBody(...) as Record<string, unknown>` old branch; this round added an independent deprecation schema, and incidentally rewrote the stale conclusion of `R11-32/33/34/36` "boundary still bare parse/as any" group to current state.
- `R11-41/R11-44`: This round continues to clean up Round 11's residual real type erasure points, removing the implicit unsafe assertions on `elementId/interactionType` in `UxEventTrackingService`, as well as `stable-runner-factory`'s `(runner as any)(runnerArgs as any)` erasure on runner signature; meanwhile `R11-37/38/39/40/42/43` were rewritten per current source code review to "original accusation outdated".
- `R6-45`: 5 short contract documents were indeed missing remediation / canonical enforcement rules, and most were less than 60 lines; this round directly added `sla_tier`, `quota_preemption`, `multimodal_gateway`, `org_hierarchy`, `feedback_improvement` remediation, export/compatibility constraints and v4.3 enforcement rules.
- `R14-01`: `platform-panic` is not "only panic_stop string enum", but `cascadeHalt()` returned an old snapshot, causing propagation result to be inconsistent with internal halting log; this round fixed the return chain and added cascade/ack/resume targeted validation.
- `R16-42`: `ConflictResolver` is no longer shallow spread, but same-`id` conflict items in arrays still solidify server old value; this round added item-level CRDT merge and Lamport fallback.
- `R20-03`: `WorkerDrainProtocol` already has drain state, but left checkpoint/lease release/recovery paths as stubs; this round wired collaboration dependencies and made `TERMINATE` phase actually execute forced handoff.
- `R20-44/45/46/49`: Added side-effect registration/pre-commit lifecycle, 5 types of workflow pre-execution static analysis, `StaticCompatibilityIssue[]` compatible export, and pre-release quality gate.
- `R25-03/04/05/06/07/08/10/12/13`: This round continues to clean up real gaps in Platform Interface / API / Channel Gateway, fixing gateway target error normalization order, standardized error response `traceId/details`, webhook nonce entropy truncation, delivery receipt false success, gateway rate limit tenant isolation, WebSocket server heartbeat, WS `maxPayload`, API rate-limit key path parameter normalization, and body read bypassing request timeout protection.
- `R25-01/02/09/11`: This group of re-audit entries continues to use old snapshots; this round added source code and targeted tests and confirmed that `matchRoute` now supports `PUT/PATCH/DELETE`, CORS default is fail-closed and rejects wildcard+credentials, `StreamBridge` replay buffer has long had bounded limits, `WebSocketBridge` has also wired tenant scope filter on both subscribe and broadcast sides.
